title: Why you should take a vacation – and how to get the most out of it, with Jessica de Bloom, PhD, and Sarah Pressman, PhD

sentences.en: It's summertime and perhaps your thoughts have been drifting to your next vacation.
sentences.zh: 现在是夏天，也许你已经在盘算着下一次假期了。

sentences.en: Maybe you're dreaming of sitting on a beach with a cool drink in hand or camping in the mountains
sentences.zh: 也许你梦想着手拿一杯清凉的饮料坐在海滩上，或者在山间露营，

sentences.en: or exploring a new city or just staying home for a week reading and binge watching TV.
sentences.zh: 或者探索一座新城市，亦或是仅仅在家待上一周，读书并疯狂追剧。

sentences.en: Whatever your idea of the perfect vacation, it's probably something that you look forward to all year.
sentences.zh: 无论你心目中的完美假期是什么样的，它大概都是你一整年都在期盼的事情。

sentences.en: Do vacations actually make people happier in the long run?
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，度假真的能让人更快乐吗？

sentences.en: How do they affect our mental health and well-being?
sentences.zh: 它们如何影响我们的心理健康和幸福感？

sentences.en: What about our physical health?
sentences.zh: 我们的身体健康呢？

sentences.en: And are some types of vacations more beneficial than others?
sentences.zh: 某些类型的假期会比其他类型更有益吗？

sentences.en: And if so, which ones?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，具体是哪几种？

sentences.en: Is it better to relax, to scurry around seeing new sites and expanding our horizons, or some combination of the two?
sentences.zh: 是好好放松更好，还是四处奔波看新景点、开阔眼界更好，亦或是两者的某种结合？

sentences.en: Just how long do the benefits of vacation last?
sentences.zh: 度假的好处究竟能持续多久？

sentences.en: Is there anything you can do to make that post-vacation glow last longer?
sentences.zh: 有什么办法能让那种度假后的余韵持续得更久一些吗？

sentences.en: And finally, how do differences in work and vacation culture affect people's mental health and well-being around the world?
sentences.zh: 最后，世界各地不同的工作与度假文化如何影响人们的心理健康和幸福感？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学对话》，这是美国心理学会的旗舰播客，主要探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: We have two guests today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天请到了两位嘉宾。

sentences.en: First is Dr. Sarah Pressman, a professor of psychological science and an associate dean at the University of California, Irvine.
sentences.zh: 第一位是加州大学尔湾分校的心理科学教授兼副院长莎拉·普雷斯曼博士。

sentences.en: Her research focuses on the interplay between stress and psychological well-being and health.
sentences.zh: 她的研究重点是压力与心理幸福感及健康之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: She has examined the role that positive emotions and behaviors play in influencing stress and health
sentences.zh: 她研究了积极情绪和行为在影响压力和健康结果方面所起的作用，

sentences.en: outcomes, and she's especially interested in understanding exactly how these positive factors get under the skin to influence our well-being.
sentences.zh: 并且她特别感兴趣的是，确切了解这些积极因素是如何“深入皮肤”来影响我们的幸福感的。

sentences.en: As part of that research, she's studied how vacations and leisure time affect people's stress levels and their physical health.
sentences.zh: 作为该研究的一部分，她研究了假期和休闲时间如何影响人们的压力水平和身体健康。

sentences.en: Our second guest is Dr. Jessica de Blum, a work and organizational psychologist and a professor at the
sentences.zh: 我们的第二位嘉宾是杰西卡·德布卢姆博士，她是一名工作与组织心理学家，也是荷兰格罗宁根大学的教授。

sentences.en: University of Groningen in the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 荷兰格罗宁根大学。

sentences.en: She studies the effects of vacation and leisure time on people's well-being and work performance, as well as how workers are being affected by the vanishing
sentences.zh: 她研究假期和休闲时间对人们幸福感和工作绩效的影响，以及当今工作与非工作生活之间日益模糊的界限如何影响劳动者。

sentences.en: boundaries between work and non-work life today.
sentences.zh: 边界日趋模糊的现状对劳动者的影响。

sentences.en: She is an international scholar who previously spent five years living and working in Finland, and she's interested in differences in work and vacation
sentences.zh: 她是一位国际学者，曾在芬兰生活和工作了五年，她对不同国家和地区的工作与度假文化的差异很感兴趣。

sentences.en: culture in different countries and regions.
sentences.zh: 文化差异感兴趣。

sentences.en: Thank you both for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢两位今天能来参加我的节目。

sentences.en: So happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 对，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So what exactly are the mental and physical health benefits of vacation?
sentences.zh: 那么，度假对心理和身体健康的具体好处究竟有哪些？

sentences.en: What have each of you found in your research?
sentences.zh: 你们各自在研究中发现了什么？

sentences.en: And maybe Dr. de Blum, we can start with you.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以从德布卢姆博士开始。

sentences.en: Yeah, I started out from existing research, analyzing, of course, what has been out there already.
sentences.zh: 好的，我最初是从现有研究出发的，当然是分析了以往已经有的成果。

sentences.en: And two very influential longitudinal studies found like they investigated large groups of healthy people.
sentences.zh: 两项极具影响力的纵向研究发现——它们调查了大量健康人群。

sentences.en: They medically examined them for nine to 20 years in these different studies.
sentences.zh: 在这些不同的研究中，对他们进行了长达九到二十年的医学检查。

sentences.en: And they both showed that not taking annual vacations was significantly associated with a higher risk for morbidity and even mortality due to heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 这两项研究都表明，不休年假与因心脏病发作导致的疾病发病率甚至死亡率风险显著增加密切相关。

sentences.en: So not taking holidays entails a health risk, you can say.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以说，不休假会带来健康风险。

sentences.en: And in my own research, I have approached this question from a slightly different lens because I followed then people that
sentences.zh: 在我自己的研究中，我从一个略微不同的角度来探讨这个问题，因为我追踪了那些

sentences.en: take a vacation and I followed them before, during and after their holidays and tracked their well-being across that time period.
sentences.zh: 去度假的人，并且在他们假期的前、中、后都进行了追踪，记录了他们在整个时期的幸福感。

sentences.en: And also there I found that people's health and well-being, in this case, self-reported health and well-being, drastically increased right when they go on the holiday.
sentences.zh: 我也发现在那个时候，人们的健康和幸福感——在本例中是自我报告的健康和幸福感——在他们去度假时会急剧上升。

sentences.en: It remains quite high in the middle part of the holiday and then vanishes very quickly or goes back to baseline once they are back at work.
sentences.zh: 在假期中间这段时间它保持得相当高，然后一旦回到工作岗位，就会非常迅速地消失或回到基线水平。

sentences.en: So within two weeks, levels of work engagement, burnout and so on go to baseline levels.
sentences.zh: 因此，在两周内，工作投入度、倦怠感等水平就会回到基线水平。

sentences.en: Dr. Pressman, does that resonate with you?
sentences.zh: 普雷斯曼博士，这与你的看法产生共鸣吗？

sentences.en: What has your research found?
sentences.zh: 你的研究发现了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: It resonates.
sentences.zh: 这很有共鸣。

sentences.en: And, you know, we've been looking more recently, especially at the cardiovascular outcomes that Dr. DeBloom mentioned, you know, really monitoring people's cardiovascular
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们最近一直在更多地关注德布卢姆博士提到的心血管结果，也就是在人们度假期间（包括度假前后）真正监测他们的心血管功能。

sentences.en: function while they go through vacation, both before and after.
sentences.zh: 功能，无论是在度假前还是度假后。

sentences.en: And what we really see is that, you know, when we look physiologically at what's happening in their body, not just these like serious
sentences.zh: 我们真正看到的是，你知道，当我们从生理角度审视他们体内发生的事情时，不仅是这些严重的后果，还有，你知道，这究竟是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: outcomes, but, you know, how is that happening?
sentences.zh: 后果，但你知道，这是如何发生的？

sentences.en: And we monitor their heart rate or their blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 我们监测他们的心率或血压。

sentences.en: What we see is that as people start anticipating their vacation, even the weeks before, you start seeing those benefits.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，当人们开始期待假期时，甚至在假期前的几周，你就能开始看到这些好处。

sentences.en: People, their stress is bothering them less.
sentences.zh: 人们受到的压力困扰变少了。

sentences.en: And what that means is that, you know, when they feel these kinds of negative emotions and anxiety and worry, it's not having the same kinds of implications for their body.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，你知道，当他们感受到这些负面情绪、焦虑和担忧时，它们对身体的影响已经不一样了。

sentences.en: And we know that that's true for not just, you know, long, serious vacations.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，这不仅适用于漫长而严肃的假期。

sentences.en: I know we're going to get to what kind of vacations help, but even just leisure, when we engage in, you know, gardening, when we engage in hobbies over
sentences.zh: 我知道我们接下来会讨论什么样的假期有帮助，但即使只是休闲，当我们进行园艺活动、在周末培养爱好时，

sentences.en: the weekend, these things also seem to have the same benefits in reducing our blood pressure, reducing our stress hormones.
sentences.zh: 这些事情似乎也有同样的好处，可以降低我们的血压、减少应激激素。

sentences.en: And these should lead to benefits to our physical health.
sentences.zh: 这些应该会给我们的身体健康带来益处。

sentences.en: You know, just like Dr. DeBloom was saying, you know, it should lead to differences in mortality and longevity and disease outcomes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如德布卢姆博士所说，这应该会带来死亡率、寿命和疾病结果方面的差异。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk for a minute about the different types and lengths of vacations.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们花一分钟来谈谈不同类型和长期的假期。

sentences.en: I want to ask whether the health benefits of staycations where people don't go anywhere, are they as robust as those of actual vacations that involve getting away from your home?
sentences.zh: 我想问一下，那些人们哪里都不去的“宅度假”，其健康益处是否和那些真正离开家的度假一样强劲？

sentences.en: I think I can really speak to the research that Dr. Pressman was already mentioning,
sentences.zh: 我想我可以谈谈普雷斯曼博士刚才提到的研究，

sentences.en: that we indeed also see that in our studies coming back, we had people, we followed people that had a domestic holiday.
sentences.zh: 我们确实也看到，在我们的研究中，我们追踪了一些进行国内度假的人。

sentences.en: So that was four or five days in their home country, so Netherlands in this case.
sentences.zh: 那是他们在自己国家（本例中为荷兰）待了四五天。

sentences.en: And we also followed people that just had a regular weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们还追踪了那些只过了一个普通周末的人。

sentences.en: And we could see there very similar patterns that also during weekends, during regular leisure time, people did recover, did report higher
sentences.zh: 我们在那里可以看到非常相似的模式，即在周末和普通休闲时间里，人们确实得到了恢复，确实报告了更高的健康和幸福感水平，并从事了他们非常喜欢的活动。

sentences.en: health and well-being levels, engaged in activities that they greatly enjoyed.
sentences.zh: 健康和幸福感水平，从事他们非常喜欢的活动。

sentences.en: So also there, we can see that.
sentences.zh: 所以在这方面，我们也能看到这一点。

sentences.en: We did see a little bit different types of activities because at home, you're maybe more likely
sentences.zh: 我们确实看到了一些不同类型的活动，因为在家时，你可能更有可能

sentences.en: to engage in chores or things that are not only enjoyable, like housework, domestic work, taking care of young children, family members that can also be exhausting.
sentences.zh: 去做家务或者不仅带来快乐的事情，比如家务活、照顾幼儿、照顾家庭成员，这些也可能让人筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: And that is maybe a bit harder in the home context to deal with that and also to get this mental detachment from work, because our laptop may be potentially
sentences.zh: 在家庭环境中应对这些事情，以及从工作中获得这种心理上的抽离，可能有点困难，因为我们的笔记本电脑可能随身携带

sentences.en: with us in the weekends and we may simply open it and, and start working.
sentences.zh: 在周末时也带在身边，我们可能随时会打开它，开始工作。

sentences.en: So that's, that's the challenge of the staycation, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是宅度假所面临的挑战，我想是这样的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's really, I think a, you know, pros and cons of staying home versus going away, because obviously we know that travel is full of so many stressors, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，留在家里和外出旅行确实各有利弊，因为很显然，我们知道旅行充满了各种压力，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, security at airports, uh, possible illnesses along the way, packing the cost of it, things going wrong.
sentences.zh: 你知道，机场安检、旅途中可能生病、收拾行李、旅行开销、事情出差错。

sentences.en: And so there are so many things that you lose control over when you're traveling, especially to far away locations that you don't have with a staycation.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你旅行时，尤其是在去往遥远的地方时，会有很多你无法掌控的事情，而宅度假则不会有这些问题。

sentences.en: But just like we heard from Dr. Bloom to Bloom, you know, there are also these consequences of staying home.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们从德布卢姆博士那里听到的那样，留在家里也会产生这些后果。

sentences.en: And so you have to kind of weigh the pros and cons, I think, and think about, you know, I think how long is your vacation going to be?
sentences.zh: 所以你必须权衡利弊，我认为，还要考虑你的假期会有多长？

sentences.en: Are you going to be able to kind of get over the travel stress so that you can truly enjoy yourself and relax in the place that you're going to?
sentences.zh: 你是否能够克服旅行带来的压力，以便在你要去的地方真正享受自我并彻底放松？

sentences.en: Because obviously going away has benefits.
sentences.zh: 因为显然外出是有好处的。

sentences.en: I mean, you might experience awe because there'll be novelty, which is a great positive emotion with a lot of benefits to physiology and health.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可能会体验到敬畏感，因为会有新鲜感，这是一种非常棒的积极情绪，对生理和健康有很多好处。

sentences.en: And you might experience obviously more, you know, social bonding when you're away from your daily life and the grind.
sentences.zh: 当你远离日常生活和繁重工作时，你显然会体验到更多的社会凝聚力。

sentences.en: And so there are so many benefits to going away, but I think that you have to balance that against the stress and make sure that you're able to
sentences.zh: 因此，外出有很多好处，但我认为你必须将其与压力进行权衡，并确保如果你确实外出了，能够真正享受你的假期。

sentences.en: really enjoy your vacation if you do go away.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实外出了，能够真正享受你的假期。

sentences.en: Well, speaking of enjoyment, if I could ask another question, what about the people who don't really unplug during vacation, the people who take their
sentences.zh: 好吧，说到享受，如果我能再问一个问题，那些在度假期间真正无法摆脱工作的人呢？也就是那些带上手机和笔记本电脑、

sentences.en: phones and their laptops, and they basically continue working while they're on vacation?
sentences.zh: 基本上在度假时还在继续工作的人呢？

sentences.en: Do they get the same health and well-being benefits as people who completely unplug?
sentences.zh: 他们能获得与完全不插电的人相同的健康和幸福感益处吗？

sentences.en: We also ask people that in our study and how much time they spend on work-related activities during their holidays.
sentences.zh: 我们在研究中也问过人们这个问题，了解他们在假期里花在工作相关活动上的时间。

sentences.en: We had phone interviews with them during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 我们在假期期间对他们进行了电话采访。

sentences.en: And we did find that quite a share of people did engage with some clients, with colleagues and so on, but they all said that
sentences.zh: 我们确实发现，相当一部分人确实与一些客户、同事等进行了接触，但他们都表示

sentences.en: it was their own choice and they could also decide the amount of time they would spend on it.
sentences.zh: 这是他们自己的选择，他们也可以决定花在上面的时间多少。

sentences.en: And in this scenario, then we didn't see the negative effects.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们就没有看到负面影响。

sentences.en: And it was on average, I think, half an hour that people spend during the holiday on work-related activities.
sentences.zh: 我想平均下来，人们在假期里花在工作相关活动上的时间大约是半小时。

sentences.en: And then we don't see the negative effects.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就没有看到负面影响。

sentences.en: What we see from other research or from Sabina Sonentag and colleagues, for instance, that this mental disengagement from work is really crucial to have that on a regular
sentences.zh: 我们从其他研究中，或者从萨宾娜·索嫩塔格（Sabina Sonnentag）及其同事的研究中看到，例如，这种心理上脱离工作对于定期进行恢复、使你的生理系统恢复到基线水平以及放松身心是至关重要的。

sentences.en: basis to really recover and get your physiological system to baseline levels and to rewind.
sentences.zh: 恢复并使你的生理系统回到基线水平以及放松身心。

sentences.en: Dr. Pressman, are there strategies that people should use in order to actually unplug during vacation?
sentences.zh: 普雷斯曼博士，人们应该采取什么策略才能在度假时真正做到不插电呢？

sentences.en: I mean, maybe you really feel like you've got to look at your email, but what can you do to keep it under control?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也许你真的觉得你必须查看电子邮件，但你可以做些什么来把它控制在合理范围内？

sentences.en: I mean, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, it does depend on how you perceive your work, whether or not you should do this, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这确实取决于你如何看待你的工作，无论你是否应该这样做，对吧？

sentences.en: Because I think for some people, the unplugging could be more stressful than not unplugging.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为对某些人来说，不插电可能会比不拔掉电源更有压力。

sentences.en: And, you know, and if you do love your job and you, you know, it's going to be worse for you not to do it, you know, that could be consequential.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果你真的很热爱你的工作，而且你知道不这样做对你更糟，那可能会产生严重后果。

sentences.en: But if you really do need the break, because like we heard just now, it is critical for us to actually restore.
sentences.zh: 但如果你真的需要休息，因为就像我们刚才听到的那样，这对于我们真正恢复精力至关重要。

sentences.en: You know, there are so many things that you can do, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，有很多事情你可以做，对吧？

sentences.en: You can leave your phone at, you know, in your hotel room, don't bring it with you.
sentences.zh: 你可以把手机留在酒店房间里，不要随身携带。

sentences.en: You can turn on an away message.
sentences.zh: 你可以开启自动回复功能。

sentences.en: There is a great trend that I've seen with people putting on fabulous away messages on email, you know, that really says,
sentences.zh: 我发现现在有一个很棒的趋势，人们在电子邮件上设置非常棒的自动回复，你知道，上面写着，

sentences.en: you know, I'm not really checking my email, like this is not something I'm doing, you know, or, you know, you know, put blocks on your phone, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的没有在看邮件，这不是我在做的事情，你知道，或者，你知道，在手机上设置屏蔽，对吧？

sentences.en: You can block your email, you can put so that maybe you only spend a certain amount of time or certain hours of the day, you're only going to look at it.
sentences.zh: 你可以屏蔽你的邮件，这样你可能只会花一定的时间，或者在一天中的某些小时内才会去看它。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, there's great technology because of the overwhelming, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，由于目前科技铺天盖地的干扰以及我们所面临的持续分心，科技真的很棒，

sentences.en: interference of technology right now and the constant distraction we have companies really have stepped up to create a lot of programs to help us, you know, take a break.
sentences.zh: 各大公司确实加大了力度，开发了许多程序来帮助我们休息。

sentences.en: And so I think you just have to commit to that seriously and, you know, promise yourself that you will give yourself a true break.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你只需要认真致力于此，并且向自己保证你会给自己一个真正的假期。

sentences.en: Is that kind of a cultural thing?
sentences.zh: 这算是一种文化现象吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I know in America, we don't take our vacations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我知道在美国，我们不怎么休假。

sentences.en: We may be given two weeks of vacation that we just feel we can't possibly take because, oh my God, something is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们可能只有两周的假期，但我们总觉得根本不可能休完，因为，天哪，总会有事情发生。

sentences.en: I'm going to miss out at work.
sentences.zh: 我会在工作中错过机会。

sentences.en: I'm just not going to get my next promotion.
sentences.zh: 我只是拿不到下一次晋升了。

sentences.en: My boss is going to know that I was away for too long.
sentences.zh: 我的老板会知道我离开的时间太长了。

sentences.en: I mean, whatever the guilt factor is, is that a particularly American thing or Dr. DeBloom, are you seeing that in other cultures as well?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，无论负罪感因素是什么，这是一种特别美国的现象吗？还是说德布卢姆博士，你在其他文化中也看到了这一点？

sentences.en: I do see it in other cultures as well.
sentences.zh: 我在其他文化中也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: I also have worked quite a lot with Japanese colleagues there.
sentences.zh: 我也和很多日本同事合作过。

sentences.en: We also see long working hours, even there's even a word for dying from overwork.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里也看到了很长的工作时间，甚至还有一个词专门用来形容“过劳死”。

sentences.en: So it's also a serious problem there.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是一个很严重的问题。

sentences.en: And also in Europe, I think I would say it's increasingly common to respond to emails outside regular working hours and burnout is becoming like a badge of honor, right?
sentences.zh: 而且在欧洲，我想说，在正常工作时间之外回复电子邮件的情况也越来越普遍，职业倦怠正在成为一种荣誉的象征，对吧？

sentences.en: Like as a sign that you have done your beSt. And I think that's very problematic.
sentences.zh: 就好像这是你已经尽力了的标志。我认为这非常成问题。

sentences.en: And in itself, you can question whether working hours is a good measure of actually performing and doing your beSt. But that is seems to be our only way.
sentences.zh: 而且本质上，你可以质疑工作时间是否是衡量实际表现和尽力而为的好指标。但这似乎是我们唯一的途径。

sentences.en: And nowadays to show our ambition or one of the few ways to easily show motivation and ambition.
sentences.zh: 并且如今这是展示我们雄心壮志的途径之一，或者说是轻松展示动力和野心的少数几种途径之一。

sentences.en: So yes, I think it's all around the world.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我认为全世界都能看到这一点。

sentences.en: You can see it.
sentences.zh: 你能看到它。

sentences.en: But yeah, maybe American culture is maybe a little bit more extreme than the average European working culture.
sentences.zh: 但是，也许美国文化比平均的欧洲工作文化要稍微极端一些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You talked a little bit about staycations and short respites from your everyday work.
sentences.zh: 你刚才谈到了宅度假以及日常工作中的短暂喘息。

sentences.en: But can a vacation be too long?
sentences.zh: 但是，假期会不会太长呢？

sentences.en: Dr. Pressman, I see you smiling.
sentences.zh: 普雷斯曼博士，我看到你在笑。

sentences.en: You have an answer for that one?
sentences.zh: 你对这个问题有答案吗？

sentences.en: I really don't know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道答案是什么。

sentences.en: I'm curious if Dr. DeBloom does, because I haven't seen a study that asked that question.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道德布卢姆博士是否知道，因为我还没看过有哪个研究问过这个问题。

sentences.en: I mean, I can imagine, obviously, if you're a working adult, well, the stress is going to start increasing the longer that you're away.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我可以想象，很显然，如果你是一个工作的成年人，嗯，你离开的时间越长，压力就会开始增加。

sentences.en: And we know that for some people, when they get back to work, it can be worse.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，对某些人来说，当他们回到工作岗位时，情况可能会更糟。

sentences.en: If the stress and you haven't kept up with things and there's a million emails in your inbox that you have to deal with and that there's things
sentences.zh: 如果压力很大，你没有跟上进度，收件箱里有一百万封邮件需要处理，还有一些

sentences.en: that you were supposed to do that you didn't do, that's obviously going to create – it's going to potentially wash out the benefits of the vacation when you get back.
sentences.zh: 你应该做却没有做的事情，那显然会造成影响——当你回去时，它可能会抵消度假带来的好处。

sentences.en: And so I think that it could be too long if you're not accounting for those factors.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果你没有考虑到这些因素，假期确实可能会太长。

sentences.en: But if the norm is, and obviously in some cultures, the norm is we take summers off or we take a month off in the summer, and that's what
sentences.zh: 但如果常态是——显然在某些文化中，常态是我们在夏天休假或者在夏天休假一个月，每个人都这么做，

sentences.en: everyone is doing, I think that that's going to potentially prevent that kind of harm at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这至少有可能防止那种伤害。

sentences.en: But I'm very curious to hear what Dr. DeBloom has to say to see if she knows.
sentences.zh: 但我非常想听听德布卢姆博士怎么说，看看她是否知道。

sentences.en: Is there the ideal number of days of vacation?
sentences.zh: 是否存在理想的度假天数？

sentences.en: Do we know that?
sentences.zh: 我们知道这一点吗？

sentences.en: We don't because it's actually really hard to investigate because people tend to take the amount of holidays that works best for them.
sentences.zh: 我们并不清楚，因为这其实非常难调查，因为人们往往会选择最适合自己的假期长度。

sentences.en: And you could think of setting up a research project in which you assign people to certain vacation duration or
sentences.zh: 你可以考虑设立一个研究项目，把人们分配到特定的假期持续时间或

sentences.en: vacation location, but then you also can really wonder what kind of people do you attract for these studies.
sentences.zh: 度假地点，但随后你也会不禁怀疑，究竟会吸引什么样的人来参加这些研究？

sentences.en: So it would never render very good results, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，这永远不会产生很好的结果。

sentences.en: So that makes it very hard to investigate the duration.
sentences.zh: 因此，这使得调查假期持续时间变得非常困难。

sentences.en: But overall, we do not see this dose-response relationship that you would maybe expect, that the longer the holiday, the longer lasting the effects are.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我们并没有看到你可能预期的那种剂量反应关系，即假期越长，效果持续时间越长。

sentences.en: So what I think more and more when I look at research on vacations, but also on shorter respites
sentences.zh: 所以，当我审视关于假期的研究，以及关于工作期间较短休息的研究时

sentences.en: from work, think of breaks, lunch breaks, and so on, that I think the regularity and having a regular
sentences.zh: ——想想休息、午休等等——我越来越觉得，规律性以及拥有一个规律的

sentences.en: break, breakout times, that's maybe much more important than having a long time out.
sentences.zh: 休息和喘息时间，可能比拥有长假要重要得多。

sentences.en: It reminds me also of the holidays in the Nordics, which is also maybe to do with the light, that they tend to have quite long summer holidays.
sentences.zh: 这也让我想起北欧的假期，这可能也与光照有关，他们的夏季假期往往相当长。

sentences.en: Because when, yeah, enjoy the sun and the sunshine and the light while it lasts, I can totally understand that.
sentences.zh: 因为当，是的，趁着阳光和光线还在，好好享受阳光，我完全理解这一点。

sentences.en: But there's always the risk when you do that, and you put all eggs in one basket, and then maybe this one holiday doesn't
sentences.zh: 但这样做总是存在风险，你把所有的鸡蛋都放在一个篮子里，然后可能这个假期

sentences.en: turn out as good as you hope, because maybe the weather is really bad, or the location is absolutely
sentences.zh: 并没有你希望的那么好，因为可能天气真的很糟糕，或者地点完全

sentences.en: not what you're expected, or you get sick during the holiday, then, yeah, you feel very bad about it, and also you don't have enough other respites throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 不是你所期望的，或者你在假期生病了，那么，是的，你会对此感到非常糟糕，而且你一整年中也没有足够的其他休息时间。

sentences.en: There are some companies in the US, and perhaps overseas, I'm not fully aware of this, but some companies in the US have said, you have unlimited vacation.
sentences.zh: 美国的一些公司，也许还有海外公司，我对此不是完全了解，但美国的一些公司表示：你们享有无限期假期。

sentences.en: As long as you do your job, you can go off for six months and, you know, trek in the Himalayas if you want to.
sentences.zh: 只要你完成了工作，如果你想的话，你可以休假六个月去，你知道的，去喜马拉雅山徒步。

sentences.en: Are people doing that?
sentences.zh: 真的有人这么做吗？

sentences.en: I mean, have you looked at any of this, and does it have any impact, or are people just still too afraid to take that much time away from their jobs?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你们看过这方面的研究吗？这有什么影响，还是说大家仍然太害怕离开工作岗位那么久？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're actually in the process of doing a research project on unlimited leave policies, and so far we have written a more conceptual piece on that
sentences.zh: 是的，我们目前正在着手进行一项关于无限期休假政策的研究项目，到目前为止，我们已经写了一篇更具概念性的文章

sentences.en: together with my colleagues, and our ideas, and also what we take from research is that,
sentences.zh: 与我的同事们一起，我们的想法，以及我们从研究中得到的是：

sentences.en: on the one hand, you have this autonomy and this really nice feeling, and that's also what we learned
sentences.zh: 一方面，你拥有这种自主权和这种非常美好的感觉，这也是我们从

sentences.en: from the first interviews we had, like, okay, I have the freedom, I don't need to save up days,
sentences.zh: 我们进行的第一次访谈中所了解到的，比如，好吧，我有了自由，我不需要攒天数，

sentences.en: because when needed, I can always take off, so this feeling of freedom that really helps people,
sentences.zh: 因为需要时我随时可以请假，所以这种自由感确实对人们有帮助，

sentences.en: improves their well-being, but on the other hand, there are social processes that, like the one that
sentences.zh: 改善了他们的幸福感；但另一方面，存在着一些社会进程，就像我们

sentences.en: we just discussed, that there's also a team that may be dependent on your work, and that you don't want to leave alone.
sentences.zh: 刚刚讨论的那样，团队可能依赖于你的工作，而你又不想把他们抛在一边。

sentences.en: There are maybe people who are more easily argue and negotiate for their well-being, and to have a longer holiday, or to have a holiday during the busy summer season when
sentences.zh: 有些人可能更容易为自己的幸福感据理力争和进行谈判，从而获得更长的假期，或者在每个人都想休假的

sentences.en: everybody wants to be off.
sentences.zh: 繁忙夏季期间休假。

sentences.en: So, there are these processes at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些过程同时存在。

sentences.en: So, one process is the unleashing, or we call it the, yeah, you really can benefit from it, but then there's also the
sentences.zh: 因此，一个过程是释放，或者我们称之为，是的，你确实可以从中受益，但随后也存在着

sentences.en: restricting process of people, like the team being strict and restricting each other potentially,
sentences.zh: 人们的限制过程，比如团队很严格，潜在地相互限制，

sentences.en: and that may lead to people taking actually less leave than they had previously when it was a fixed amount, and everybody had the same, and you have a norm to stick to.
sentences.zh: 这可能会导致人们实际休假的时间比以前还要少，当时假期是固定天数，每个人都一样，而且有一个你要遵守的规范。

sentences.en: What about those people who spend their vacations viewing everything through the camera on their cell phone?
sentences.zh: 那些把假期花在通过手机摄像头观察一切的人呢？

sentences.en: Are they getting the same benefits as people who use their phones or other cameras a little more judiciously?
sentences.zh: 与那些更明智地使用手机或其他摄像头的人相比，他们获得的好处是一样的吗？

sentences.en: Dr. Pressman, any thoughts on that?
sentences.zh: 普雷斯曼博士，您对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: No, I mean, it's a really interesting question.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，这是一个非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: You know, there have been studies that have used smartphones as a way to savor, and so if you're not familiar with the concept of savoring, it's
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些研究将智能手机用作一种细细品味的方式，如果你对“品味”这个概念不熟悉，它其实就是

sentences.en: really being in the moment, really trying to experience something positive and lengthen how long it affects you.
sentences.zh: 全身心投入当下，真正努力去体验积极的事物，并延长它影响你的时间。

sentences.en: And so, you know, typically with savoring, we do that by, you know, meditating on it, or just trying to be in the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，通常在品味体验时，我们会通过，你知道的，对此进行冥想，或者只是努力活在当下。

sentences.en: But there have been studies where they say, oh, well, you should take a picture of it so that you can remember it and like recall it and take it.
sentences.zh: 但有些研究提出：哦，好吧，你应该拍张照片，这样你就能记住它，并能回忆和留住它。

sentences.en: So I think it doesn't have to be a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这不一定是件坏事。

sentences.en: But what we also know is that having your phone with you all the time, I mean, it's not just the taking the picture, right?
sentences.zh: 但我们也知道，手机一直随身携带，我的意思是，这不仅仅是拍照的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: It's the fact that you're going to get notifications and that you might go on social media.
sentences.zh: 而是你会收到通知，而且你可能会刷社交媒体这一事实。

sentences.en: And so there's other things that are taking out of the moment besides the photograph, right?
sentences.zh: 所以除了照片之外，还有其他事情在把我们从当下拉开，对吧？

sentences.en: And so I actually had an interview recently with someone who was really interested in this phenomenon where some people are turning back the clock and using flip phones.
sentences.zh: 所以我最近实际上采访了一位学者，他非常关注这样一种现象：有些人正在倒拨时钟，开始使用翻盖手机。

sentences.en: So like the old fashioned, like, you know, from 10 years ago, maybe even longer than
sentences.zh: 就像那种老式的，你知道的，十年前的，甚至可能比

sentences.en: 10 years ago, you know, pre smartphone kinds of phones for this exact reason, because they want
sentences.zh: 十年前还要久远的，智能手机出现之前的手机，正是出于这个原因，因为他们希望

sentences.en: to be in the moment, they want to not be distracted, they don't want to be searching the internet for everything.
sentences.zh: 活在当下，不希望受到干扰，不希望凡事都在网上搜索。

sentences.en: And so I think, you know, Kim, like you said, I think that's that for some people, it is a problem, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，金，正如你所说，我认为对于某些人来说，这确实是一个问题，对吧？

sentences.en: That they're unable to be in the moment and really take in the positive experience that they're having, if they're distracted by what's going on.
sentences.zh: 如果他们被正在发生的事情分心，他们就无法活在当下，无法真正吸收他们正在经历的积极体验。

sentences.en: And certainly, you know, I do worry, you know, when you see people at a concert and the entire time they're filming, you know, are they really enjoying it as much?
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道，当你看到人们在音乐会上全程都在拍摄时，我确实会担心：你知道，他们真的能尽情享受吗？

sentences.en: But I have mixed feelings about it, because I think if you do film it, and you're able to keep reliving it over and over again,
sentences.zh: 但我对此有着复杂的情感，因为我认为如果你拍摄了视频，并且能够一遍又一遍地重温它，

sentences.en: you're getting a positive emotion boost from that as well.
sentences.zh: 你也能从中获得积极情绪的提升。

sentences.en: And so I think you have to kind of figure out what's right for you, you know, are you able to still enjoy it while you're filming it?
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得你必须弄清楚什么对你最合适，你知道，你在拍摄时还能不能好好享受它？

sentences.en: You know, I wouldn't want to lose out on a precious memory of my five year old, because I didn't take a video of it, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我可不想因为没拍视频而失去关于我五岁孩子的珍贵记忆，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, so for some of us, it's like, we want the ability to relive that over and over.
sentences.zh: 所以对我们中的一些人来说，我们希望有能力一遍又一遍地重温那一刻。

sentences.en: And certainly with vacations, you may want to, you know, if you see a whale swim by as you're out in the ocean, you know, you might regret not taking a picture of that.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于假期，如果你在海里时看到一头鲸鱼游过，你知道，你可能会后悔没有拍下照片。

sentences.en: And so I wouldn't want people to not document because they're worried of not being in the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想让人们因为担心无法活在当下而放弃记录。

sentences.en: Yeah, and maybe to add to that, this social element is maybe also an important one, that that it's also possible then to share your experiences with people that are not with you at
sentences.zh: 是的，也许还要补充一点，这种社交元素可能也是一个重要的因素，也就是说，这样你就可以和那些当时

sentences.en: the moment, but that, yeah, that enjoy the memory with you, the moment.
sentences.zh: 不在你身边的人分享你的体验，但他们可以，是的，和你一起享受那段记忆，那个时刻。

sentences.en: We talked a little bit earlier about how long that after vacation glow lasts.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才简要谈到了假期过后的余韵能持续多久。

sentences.en: What's a typical timeframe once you've come back to your regular life, for you to still feel the benefits of the relaxation, the fact that I had a great time.
sentences.zh: 当你回到正常生活后，还能感受到放松带来的益处、那种“我度过了一段美好时光”的感觉，通常的时限是多久？

sentences.en: And then you get back into the grind.
sentences.zh: 然后你就得重新回到日复一日的忙碌中。

sentences.en: How long does the glow last?
sentences.zh: 这种余韵能持续多久？

sentences.en: Do we know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, very short.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常短。

sentences.en: I can tell.
sentences.zh: 我完全可以告诉你。

sentences.en: So in the studies that we have done, and we looked at domestic holidays, so four or five days, we looked at winter sports holidays of a week
sentences.zh: 所以在我们进行的研究中，我们考察了国内度假，大约四到五天；我们考察了平均为期一周的

sentences.en: on average, and on long holidays, like three weeks on average.
sentences.zh: 冬季运动假期，以及平均为期三周的长假。

sentences.en: And they all had similar effects in terms of like, in the first week after returning home from the holiday, they were back to how they felt before, which was also good, right?
sentences.zh: 在度假回家后的第一周内，它们在各个方面都有相似的效果：人们的状态回到了出发前，这也是好事，对吧？

sentences.en: Because they are healthy employees and happy with their job.
sentences.zh: 因为他们是健康的员工，对工作也很满意。

sentences.en: And but yeah, that's about the lasting benefits in terms of health and well being, right?
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，在健康和幸福感的持久收益方面，也就持续这么久，对吧？

sentences.en: But I think there are much more effects that we didn't capture that do laSt. And then I'm thinking, for example,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得还有更多我们没有捕捉到的、能够持久产生影响的效果。这时我想到了，例如：

sentences.en: my colleague does research on couple experiences, and they see that couples do engage more actively with each other in their relationship when they are on holidays.

sentences.zh: 去大自然中露营，做一些能让我们置身于不同环境但又没有长途旅行烦恼的事情，同样也很美好。

sentences.en: And that also reminds me a little bit of this slow travel movement that has also now been investigated a little bit that it showed that
sentences.zh: 这也让我想起了慢旅行运动，现在这种运动也受到了一些研究的关注，研究表明

sentences.en: when people, the distance, the actual distance cover doesn't really matter for the feeling of being away, but it's more the time it takes to get there.
sentences.zh: 当人们出行时，实际覆盖的距离对于那种“远离日常生活”的感觉其实并不重要，更重要的是到达那里所花费的时间。

sentences.en: So when you would go by bike or maybe take the train, take a slower mode of transportation, you can feel away from home while still being relatively close.
sentences.zh: 所以当你骑自行车或者乘火车，选择一种较慢的交通方式时，你既能感受到远离家门，同时又离得相对较近。

sentences.en: So I think that's a nice way of thinking about it and rethinking maybe where we want to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这是一种很好的思考方式，也许能让我们重新思考我们想去哪里。

sentences.en: And I think it probably also, it relates to the individual differences we were talking about before with people's differences in where they want to go on vacation.
sentences.zh: 而且我想它可能也与我们之前讨论过的个体差异有关，也就是人们在度假目的地选择上的差异。

sentences.en: I think that now we saw in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在在美国

sentences.en: at least huge surges in the number of people booking flights last summer, right?
sentences.zh: 至少看到去年夏天预订机票的人数大幅激增，对吧？

sentences.en: So this has really been a huge increase since the pandemic, but it's not everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以自疫情以来这确实有了巨大的增长，但并非所有人都是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I think there are people who maybe the more introverted people, maybe the people who don't have as much of a need for
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得有些人可能更内向，可能那些对新鲜事物

sentences.en: novelty, aren't sensation seekers, you know, so there's like these personality differences where I think
sentences.zh: 没有那么强需求、也不是寻求刺激的人，你知道的，所以存在这些性格差异，我认为

sentences.en: some people really suffered during the pandemic because they weren't going away.
sentences.zh: 有些人因为疫情期间不能外出而备受煎熬。

sentences.en: And other people were like, you know, maybe I, maybe I can just rent an Airbnb an hour and away and that feels just as good.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则会想，你知道的，也许我可以就在一小时路程外租个爱彼迎，感觉也同样很好。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think the, the climate changed thing is really also having a big impact.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我认为气候变化的问题确实也产生了很大的影响。

sentences.en: I've seen a lot fewer people, at least in academics, going to conferences for that reason,
sentences.zh: 我看到少了很多很多的人，至少在学术界，出于这个原因去参加会议，

sentences.en: where, you know, maybe because of the pandemic, you know, they're realizing that the state of our planet is really important.
sentences.zh: 在那里，你知道的，也许是因为疫情，他们意识到我们地球的现状真的很重要。

sentences.en: And if they can do small things, you know, then they don't need to maybe travel quite as much as they used to.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能做一些小事情，你知道的，那么他们也许就不需要像过去那样频繁地旅行了。

sentences.en: So what are the big questions that you both want to answer through your research?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们两人都希望通过研究来回答的重大问题是什么？

sentences.en: What are you looking at now?
sentences.zh: 你们现在正在关注什么？

sentences.en: Dr. DeBloom, let's start with you.
sentences.zh: 德布卢姆博士，我们先从您开始吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, this project on unlimited leave, I was briefly touching upon, I think this really
sentences.zh: 好的，关于无上限休假这个项目，我刚才简要提到了，我觉得这确实

sentences.en: is high on my research agenda to understand these processes that make people on the one hand feel this freedom, this flexibility.
sentences.zh: 是我研究议程中的重中之重，旨在理解那些一方面让人感到这种自由和灵活性，

sentences.en: And but at the same time, also, sometimes resulting in self exploitation or not taking off anymore or not taking good care of yourself.
sentences.zh: 但同时又有时会导致自我剥削、或者不再休假、或者不再好好照顾自己的这些过程。

sentences.en: And so understanding, why this happens, how it happens, and also how you can prevent that on a more systemic level,
sentences.zh: 因此，理解为什么会发生这种情况，它是如何发生的，以及如何在更系统的层面上防止这种情况，

sentences.en: as a company, as a team, as a leader, what role do all these elements play in making it work?
sentences.zh: 作为一家公司、一个团队、一位领导者，所有这些要素在让它发挥作用方面扮演着什么角色？

sentences.en: Because I think, in fact, it's, I like the idea of flexibility and giving autonomy.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，事实上，我很喜欢灵活性和赋予自主权的想法。

sentences.en: But we somehow need to create boundary conditions that that really help to make it beneficial for everyone.
sentences.zh: 但我们某种程度上需要创造边界条件，真正帮助每个人从中受益。

sentences.en: Dr. Pressman, what are you looking at now?
sentences.zh: 普雷斯曼博士，您现在在关注什么？

sentences.en: Um, you know, my big interest has always been how do we protect ourselves against the harms of stress,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我一直以来的最大兴趣是如何保护自己免受压力的危害，

sentences.en: and really being able to give people advice that is targeted to the context that they're living in.
sentences.zh: 并且真正能够向人们提供针对他们所处生活环境的量身定制的建议。

sentences.en: And so I would love it if we could figure out better, you know, depending on what's going on in your life, what is the best vacation for you to take?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们能更好地弄清楚，你知道的，根据你生活中的实际情况，什么才是最适合你的假期，我会非常高兴。

sentences.en: Or what is the best thing that you could do in terms of even, you know, how you spend your time off on a daily basis?
sentences.zh: 或者从日常休假时间的分配方式来看，你能做的最好的事情是什么？

sentences.en: You know, what's the right advice?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，什么样的建议才是正确的？

sentences.en: Um, you know, and especially the thing I've gotten very interested in is energy from a psychological perspective, which I know, Dr. DeBloom is doing some work on as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我特别感兴趣的是从心理学角度来看的精力问题，我知道德布卢姆博士也在做这方面的一些工作。

sentences.en: Because I think that that's something the pandemic has triggered is, is our own psychological energy crisis, where I think we're all just feeling more depleted than we ever had.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这是疫情引发的问题之一，也就是我们自身的心理精力危机，我觉得我们所有人都比以往任何时候都感到更加精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And so trying to understand that better, in terms of how do we help people feel more vigorous and energized in their day to day life,
sentences.zh: 因此，试图从如何帮助人们在日常生活中感到更有活力和精力的角度来更好地理解这一点，

sentences.en: be it how they spend their time off or how they spend their day to day?
sentences.zh: 无论是他们如何度过假期还是如何度过日常生活，

sentences.en: I think that's a really critical question right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实是当前一个至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: Well, I want to thank you both for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 好的，我要感谢两位今天能来参加我的节目。

sentences.en: I think the bottom line for our listeners is take your vacations.
sentences.zh: 我想给我们听众的最终建议是：去度假吧。

sentences.en: It's good for your health, your physical health and your mental health.
sentences.zh: 这对你的健康有益，包括身体健康和心理健康。

sentences.en: I want to thank you both for reemphasizing that.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢两位再次强调这一点。

sentences.en: And I hope you both have some a nice vacation in your futures too.
sentences.zh: 我也希望你们两人的未来都能有一个美好的假期。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。
